book.name: iJɔn
book.title: Esɔ Osuse mi abɔ mgbi iJɔn

content: IYesu kyata eni yɛɛ eneekwɔ
Mi egbe ongwu ta ma eba okwokyiikwokyi dzɛ ogalu iKana mi ɛsɛ iGalalia. Onɔ iYesu dzɛ ele,
nɛ iYesu yi engwafɔ mgban kpaa a bɔ ma eba okwokyiikwokyi nani.
Ngwi eneekwɔ wa ngyɛ nɛ, onɔ iYesu nyan gbɛɛ, <<A sulu eneekwɔ wuba.>>
IYesu nyan gbɛɛ, <<Onɛn, li ekyɛ ngwi abu kye ani le wokɛ ele? Onɔ mgbi ani gyɔ waba.>>
Onɔn si nya engbidɔ ntona gbɛɛ, <<Kyɔ alungwɔ ngwi o nya ema duu.>>
Atankpɛ akwutsɛ mgbi eni nghi egyin to kwɛkwɛ mi imbe nani, itɔ ngwi emi iJuda li sa ewoma mi odzɛɛdzɛ aletɔ mgbi ama mani, ali atankpɛ li kye ikpɔkpɔ eni mɛ osu lu osudiwyo.
IYesu nya engbidɔ ntona gbɛɛ, <<Kweni mbwo atankpɛ ntonɛ na.>> A si kweni mbwo ma kyɛɛ kyɛɛ.
Ta o nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Onɛnɛ yɔ, mwa ka nu ongyukwo mgbi oga nɛ tsatso na.>> A si kyɔ dafi o gbɔ mani,
man ongyukwo mgbi oga nɛ mbadi eni ngwi o kyatan yɛɛ eneekwɔ nani. O ye imbe ngwi eneekwɔ nɛ tɔkyɛ ba, kpaa engbidɔ ama nkweni ma ye. O kwu obongyaa ofufɛ ela lu enggengga,
ka gbɛɛ, <<Ali inggisɛ li teyi kye eneekwɔ osuse tasɛ se wa kye obube ba olɛlɛ onɔ ngwi ingyoga wa ungwɔ kpakpa mani, nghaduu abu kye osuse da nghataa ba onɛnɛni.>>
Nɛnɛ li ambɛ okwulewo ongwi ababɔ ngwi iYesu kyɔ mi iKana mi iGalalia. O kye okwɔkwɔ mgban tso, nɛta engwafɔ mgban si kye oyɛyɛ onuunu mgbi ama byikɛ mbon.
IYesu gbosa ozu okwukwo osunuImgbasho mi iJerosalin
Ungwɔnɛ wa ngyɛ man o lu iKapenahun yi onɔn yi emi ongwunɔn bɛyi engwafɔ mgban. A la imbe na egbe efa.
Ngwi oga owɛ owatɔ-watɔ mgbi emi iJuda na wa dzɛ kwɛkwɛ nɛ, iYesu lu iJerosalin.
O ka to ifoozu okwukwo osunu Imgbasho mi iJerosalin nani, o di inggisɛ tole kye mnda, mmala yi anyama le gya, angbeka sɔto ewo adinyatsɛ tole nyinɛ awuya.

Ta o shi onitse mi osha, si lɔ ma onya duu tasɛ mi ifoozu okwukwo osunu Imgbasho, bɛyi emi mmala yi mnda tsatsa; o kye ganya awuya mi adinyatsɛ mgbi ama onyinɛ awuya di kyi kyata adinyatsɛ ma tukwu esɛ.
Ama nkye anyama le gya ma o nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Gbelu ungwɔ ntonɛ tasɛ mmɛnɛ na! Kyɔnɛ ngwi ema kyata ozu mgbi Otsani yɛɛ idu!>>
Engwafɔ wɛ dafi a lɔ gbɛɛ, <<Okpitukwu mgbi ani mi ikye ozu mgbi abu le gbɛ mi itukwu mgbi ani dafi ola mani.>>
Emi iJuda byita gbɛɛ, <<Li ali ambɛ okwulewo ngwi abu ka yagba tso eyi zukwu ni eyi difwi mfye ngwi abu sulun se kyɔ itɔ ungwɔ ntonɛnɛ?>>
IYesu nu ma uka gbɛɛ, <<Gbobu ozu okwukwo osunu Imgbasho nɛni, ta ani ka yilen mbɛ mi egbe eta.>>
Emi iJuda byun gbɛɛ, <<I kye onova ngwusefa dɔn egyin ombɛ ozu nɛni, nghanɛ abu ka yilen mbɛ mi egbe eta taa?>>
Nghaduu ozu okwukwo osunu Imgbasho ngwi o le gbɔdzan na li ewo mgban.
Mi onɔ ngwi a wa kyilon mi ikwongye ma se engwafɔɔn wa ka wɛ odzɛ ngwi o teyi gbɔ nani. Man a si noyɛyɛ mi afɛ bɛyi elodzɛ ngwi iYesu teyi gbɔ.
Dafi o ka dzɛ iJerosalin mi oga owɛ owatɔ-watɔ mgbi emi Israi nɛ, inggisɛ kwuba di ambɛ okwulewo ama ngwi o le kyɔ nɛta, a noyɛyɛ mi iyi mgban.
Nghaduu iYesu gbela kye ewon nu ma ba, bana o ye ngyɛ ali inggisɛ duu.
O mina obwɛndɛ mgbi inggisɛ ikye inggisɛ ba, ikyekyɛ o teyi ye ungwɔ nwodzɛ mbi inggisɛ mani.
